heroHeadline: Ceasefire Holds Uneasily as Thailand and Cambodia Shift to Fence-Building Amid Lingering Border Violations
heroSubtitle: More than a year after the May 2025 flashpoint and the deadly July 2025 confrontation, the December 27, 2025 joint ceasefire remains formally in place despite violations in January and February 2026. Both sides have pivoted to fence construction and infrastructure works in disputed sectors, with hundreds of thousands still displaced.
